name: knowledge-handover
description: Interview someone about how they really do their job and turn it into a Knowledge Pack: one zip with a browser walkthrough, the giver's real screenshots or photos, urgent handover items and a file any AI can teach from. For anyone leaving, changing role or going on leave, and for the person taking over.

interface.shortDescription: Hand over your work before you leave
interface.longDescription:
People leave. Knowledge shouldn't.

Knowledge Handover interviews the person who does the work, mostly through tappable choices, and captures how the work really happens and why: steps, exceptions, pending work, accounts to transfer and the giver's own screenshots or on-site photos.

The result is one Knowledge Pack: START-HERE.html opens in any browser with urgent items first and step-by-step walkthroughs; PACK-FOR-AI.md lets any AI teach the successor. Every item is marked Confirmed, Needs confirmation or Open question, so nobody mistakes a guess for a rule. No server and no account: packs are files you keep.
defaultPrompt: I'm leaving next month. Help me hand over my work.
Teach me from this knowledge pack.
Here is my save block, let's continue the handover.
